correctness.rationale: Replayed p=13 and p=29 end-to-end (verify_hurwitz.py): class equations sum to 1092 (9 classes) and 12180 (17 classes), matching ATLAS class counts; Frobenius counts cross-checked fiber-vs-full agree (N=2184/type p13, N=24360/type p29); C_G(2A)-orbit reduction arithmetic holds (24=2x12, 56=2x28); all reps attain full group order. Replayed q=27 enumeration (verify_hurwitz_27.py): 9828 elements, 16 classes summing to 9828, sizes/centralizers match ATLAS L2(27) pattern (2A:351, 3A/3B:364 each, 7A/B/C:702 each), |C(2A)|=28, N=9828/type, 1 rep/type all GENERATES. Independently verified every exhibited word with separate matrix code (no reuse of candidate BFS for verdicts): p13 A=[[0,1],[12,0]], B=[[1,2],[5,11]] gives |A|=2,|B|=3,|AB|=7; all three w3 have order 3, A*w3 order 7 with traces 3/5/6 distinguishing the three 7-classes, subgroup BFS orders all 1092 (third word full string verified: order 3, product 7, suborder 1092). p29 A=[[0,1],[28,0]], B=[[0,4],[7,1]] gives |A|=2,|B|=3,|AB|=7; all three w3 order 3, products order 7 with traces 3/7/11, suborders all 12180. q27 base A=[0,1,2,0], B=[1,0,9,1] over GF(27)=F3[t]/(t^3+2t+1) gives |A|=2,|B|=3,|AB|=7; all six w3 words independently evaluate to order 3, products order 7, suborders all 9828, with traces landing in claimed 3- and 7-classes. Genera g=1+|G|/84 give 14/118/146 exactly; |G| divisible by 84 in all three PSL cases. M11 control correct: 7920=2^4*3^2*5*11, 7920 mod 7 = 3, so no element of order 7; ATLAS M11 class list (1A,2A,3A,4A,5A,6A,8A,8B,11A,11B) corroborates. C_G(x0)-orbit reduction is a valid completeness argument for fixed-x0 fiber. Computation is exact enumeration/BFS proof, not heuristic. Presentation defect noted under residual risks (q27 word-search code not in shipped script) but does not falsify any headline number: the archived q27 words themselves verify correct.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison against nearest priors, not timestamps. ATLAS L2(13) standard generators are a(2),b(3),ab=13 and ATLAS L2(29) are a(2),b(3),ab=29 (fetched live) — no (2,3,7) word is displayed there, so the p13/p29 Hurwitz words and 3-type tables are not database replay. ATLAS L2(27) standard generators ARE a(2),b(3),ab=7, so bare Hurwitz existence for L2(27) (and for L2(13)/L2(29) via classical Macbeath criterion) was known; the claimed unit is not that existential pair but the complete class-resolved profile: 6 types distinguishing 3A/3B x 7A/7B/7C with exact per-type Frobenius constants N=9828, per-type generation verdicts, and new explicit words with replay logs — ATLAS publishes classes but no per-(2X,3Y,7Z) generation table. Conder triangle-quotient / big-surface-action lists (fetched homepage index) record quotients by genus/type/order with relators (existence-level), not class-triple-resolved Frobenius-plus-word tables for this window. No located ATLAS/Conder source publishes the per-class N values plus word witnesses as one verifiable unit for {13,27,29}+M11. All exhibited p13/p29 words satisfy |AB|=7 by construction and differ verbatim from ATLAS standard pairs; q27 novelty is the full 6-type table, honestly disclosed as such.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of natural objects, motivated before computation: which (2,3,7) class-triple types generate PSL(2,13)/PSL(2,27)/PSL(2,29) governs actual surface-group epimorphisms, Hurwitz-surface actions, regular maps and dessins beyond bare Macbeath existence. Values were not known or mechanically implied: genera g=14/118/146 are mechanical (1+|G|/84) but the uniform-generation verdicts (all 3 / all 6 types generate), the exact per-type Frobenius constants (2184/24360/9828), and the explicit word witnesses in committed Hurwitz base pairs are not implied by orders or character-table existence alone and are reusable for constructions. A future researcher needing the precise participating 7-class or a concrete (2,3,7) pair in a fixed base pair could reasonably retrieve this datum. M11 arithmetic control (7920 indivisible by 7/84) is elementary and honestly labeled as boundary-only; it does not substitute for the census but does not erase the headline. This is a narrow exact datum, not a general theorem, but it meets the explicit standard for a motivated exact invariant of a natural object. Not a textbook restatement, not a mere parameter substitution without refinement, not an unexplained enumeration: every type carries a verdict plus a verified witness.
